categories.main_business_segments: The company operates three primary business segments: Software and Digital Technology Services, Computing Products and Intelligent Electronics, and Digital Energy and Smart Computing Services. The Software and Digital Technology Services segment provides consulting, cloud services, data services, AI and large model services, industrial internet, and enterprise management software. The Computing Products and Intelligent Electronics segment includes PC terminals, enterprise-level servers, storage products, and basic software. The Digital Energy and Smart Computing Services segment focuses on power digitalization and intelligent computing infrastructure.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies including cloud computing, big data, IoT, artificial intelligence, large language models, and open-source technologies such as HarmonyOS, OpenEuler, and OpenGauss databases. Production methods include cloud-native development, DevOps, machine vision, AI quality inspection, and integrated hardware-software solutions. The company also employs ODM (Original Design Manufacturing) and OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturing) models for computing products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include major ICT enterprises, internet companies, telecommunications operators, financial institutions, manufacturing enterprises, and government agencies. Key industries served include telecommunications, finance, manufacturing, energy, education, healthcare, retail, and transportation. The company serves over 2,600 domestic and international customers, including more than 230 Fortune 500 or China 500 companies.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates across China with major service delivery centers in Beijing, Shanghai, Shenzhen, Hangzhou, Nanjing, Chengdu, Xi'an, Wuhan, Guangzhou, and Wuxi. Internationally, the company has expanded to over 60 cities globally, with recent focus on emerging markets including the Middle East, Southeast Asia, North Africa, and other regions. The company has established overseas entities in Turkey, Saudi Arabia, Thailand, and Indonesia.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple supply chain positions: downstream in software and digital services delivery, midstream in computing product manufacturing and distribution, and upstream in technology development and innovation. The company integrates hardware and software capabilities, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider rather than a single-point supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus centers on the 'Four Modernizations' (智能化、自主化、绿色化、国际化): intelligentization, autonomization, greening, and internationalization. R&D priorities include AI and large language model applications, open-source ecosystem development (HarmonyOS, OpenEuler, OpenGauss), humanoid robotics, cloud-native technologies, and industrial IoT. The company emphasizes 'All in AI' strategy and software-hardware integration.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through multiple models: product sales (computing products and intelligent electronics), professional services (consulting, implementation, and maintenance), cloud services (subscription and usage-based), software licensing, and managed services. Revenue is derived from direct sales to enterprise customers and through channel partnerships and resellers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading provider in China's IT services market, ranked first in 2023 according to Saituo Consultant's research. Major competitors include other large IT service providers and system integrators. In PC market, the company ranks second domestically in Q4 2024 with 9% market share. The company competes on comprehensive solution capabilities, industry expertise, and integrated hardware-software offerings.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company achieved 2024 revenue of 31.32 billion yuan, representing 78.13% year-over-year growth from 17.58 billion yuan in 2023. Net profit attributable to parent company shareholders was 1.80 billion yuan in 2024 (down 66.21% from 5.34 billion yuan in 2023). Total assets reached 23.18 billion yuan at year-end 2024. The company demonstrates significant growth trajectory with strategic acquisitions driving business expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through comprehensive full-stack intelligent solutions combining software services, computing products, and smart services. Key value propositions include: integrated hardware-software ecosystem, AI-driven digital transformation consulting, industry-specific solutions, open-source technology leadership, and global delivery capabilities. The company emphasizes end-to-end service delivery, industry deep expertise, and innovation in emerging technologies like AI, robotics, and green computing.
